feature_under_test: Recruiting-extension bounded execution batch envelope under a controlled five-times H2 item peak

environment.mysql: 8.4 isolated container, separate non-root migration/runtime users
environment.artifact_provider: one local Atoll daemon File Resource provider
environment.controlled_origin: ephemeral container on a Docker --internal network
environment.origin_address_class: public-shaped 11.254.x.x routed only inside the ephemeral internal network

capacity_assessment.interpretation: the controlled five-times item peak completes without lost facts or leaked permits, but sustained queue and coordination latency reduce single-host throughput below H2 and below the frozen 400K-in-8h arithmetic reference
capacity_assessment.phase_latency_interpretation: phase samples are intentionally bounded to the most recent 1,000 Attempts; batch phase values include whole-batch waiting and sequential execution and are not per-item network round trips
capacity_assessment.scaling_implication: the next throughput gate requires multiple isolated executor and control shards under an external deployment topology, not a larger in-process Worker taxonomy or an Atoll core change
capacity_assessment.projection_scope: arithmetic gap indicator only; it excludes Listing, failures, third-party latency, Browser, and remote storage

non_claims: third-party latency, throttling, CDN, or availability behavior
Browser response capture at the same peak

acceptance.reason: the controlled five-times execution peak is now proven correct, but its sustained single-host rate is below the reference and external, full-shape, remote-storage, and long-window gates remain
